latest_release.name: Seek and Destroy 1.38.6
latest_release.body:
# ZoneMinder 1.38.6 Release Notes

This is a packaging fix for 1.38.5. Its code is 1.38.5's, with one build change.

1.38.5's RPM builds failed on Rocky Linux 8, whose GCC 8 needs `libstdc++fs` linked
explicitly for `std::filesystem`. Because that one target failed, no 1.38.5 RPM packages
were published for any distribution. 1.38.6 links `stdc++fs` where the compiler needs it,
so RPM packages are available again. Debian and Ubuntu packages were unaffected.

**If you are upgrading from 1.38.4 or earlier, read the
[1.38.5 release notes](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zoneminder/releases/tag/1.38.5)**,
including its upgrade notes. 1.38.5 is primarily a security release and fixes 19 reported
vulnerabilities, and all of those fixes are in 1.38.6.

## 🐛 Fixes
- Link `stdc++fs` for `std::filesystem` on GCC 8 (Rocky Linux 8 and similar)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zoneminder/compare/1.38.5...1.38.6
